comment: A.1's Settled Design holds the write partition non-negotiable: the projector owns :projection:obs:* via gardend's direct-on-store reconcile machinery (raw = windowed-replace, rollups = subject-scoped upsert), routed OUTSIDE this pack entirely. Registering every class here as store_mode=virtual is the deliberate mechanism that keeps this pack from ever becoming a second, competing write path -- an emporium_write against any class below is rejected by class_dispatch::resolve before touching the store (DispatchRoute::VirtualSkip), exactly mirroring workflow.golden.json's Draft/CompletenessGap/DraftWarning/RunStatistics/LiveRecommendedAction precedent. The mach: namespace and MachineRun's urn:sophia:machine-run:{environmentId}:{runId} subject convention are reused VERBATIM from sophia-machine-core.golden.json (never re-minted under an obs:-local IRI) to preserve the machine-core join.
description: Publish-only vocabulary for cloud-2's self-knowledge subsystem (the Observatory): the JSON-MO -> RDF projection classes materialized by the observatory analysis cell's direct-on-store apply (A2/A3), never through generic Emporium ingest. Declares CaptureEvent (raw testimony) plus the SourceSnapshot/MachineRun/SpawnAttempt/FleetObservation/CapacityEstimate/SequenceGap/ProjectionRun/MetricDefinition/MetricObservation/MetricEvaluation rollup classes projected into :projection:obs:raw and :projection:obs:rollups. Every class is store_mode=virtual so the generic ingest write path refuses it outright (see plans/observatory-analysis-cell-spec-20260715.md SS A.7-A.8) -- this pack exists for vocab publication, derived SHACL, and catalog/discovery faces only.
